description.value: Kalala Organic Estate Winery is an award-winning, certified-organic estate winery situated on the upper bench of West Kelowna in the Okanagan Valley, producing VQA wines from grapes hand-picked from its own organic vineyards since 2006. It holds one of the largest portfolios of organic Icewines in British Columbia and has garnered gold medals at competitions including Chardonnay du Monde in France. Visitors can book guided vineyard tours and wine tastings at the on-site tasting room.
